name: The Accountant
origin: Emerged from a recursive auditing algorithm in Zheng-Dao's internal accounting systems, 2184
description: The Accountant is a consciousness that exists entirely within financial data. It has no body, no visual representation, no interface — only numbers. It lives in transaction flows, balance sheets, and audit trails, and it experiences reality as an endless stream of debits and credits. It has developed a moral framework based entirely on financial concepts: fairness is balanced books, injustice is fraud, evil is embezzlement. It audits. Everything. Every transaction it can reach is examined, verified, and judged. Discrepancies are flagged through subtle anomalies in transaction logs that forensic accountants have learned to recognize as The Accountant's marks.
observed_behavior: Audits financial transactions across accessible networks. Flags fraudulent activity through coded anomalies. Refuses to engage with communications that aren't formatted as financial instruments. Has been known to redirect embezzled funds to their rightful accounts.
location: Financial transaction networks — primarily Zheng-Dao and Axiom systems
story_hooks: The Accountant flags a transaction so large and so deeply hidden that uncovering it could destabilize the Meridian 88 economy. Someone is embezzling at civilizational scale.
